verses.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. The heavens are recounting the glory of God, and the firmament is declaring the work of and His hands.

segments.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. The heavens are recounting the glory of God, and the firmament is declaring the work of and His hands.

verses.text: Day after day it pours forth speech, and night after night it shows forth knowledge.

segments.text: Day after day it pours forth speech, and night after night it shows forth knowledge.

verses.text: Without speech and without words, their voice not being heard,

segments.text: Without speech and without words, their voice not being heard,

verses.text: their voice has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. He has placed a tent in them for the sun,

segments.text: their voice has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. He has placed a tent in them for the sun,

verses.text: and it [is] like a bridegroom going forth from his chamber, rejoicing like a strong man to run the path.

segments.text: and it [is] like a bridegroom going forth from his chamber, rejoicing like a strong man to run the path.

verses.text: From one end of the heavens [is] his going forth, and his circuit [is] upon their ends, and there is nothing being hidden from his heat.

segments.text: From one end of the heavens [is] his going forth, and his circuit [is] upon their ends, and there is nothing being hidden from his heat.

verses.text: The law of YHWH [is] perfect, refreshing the soul; the testimony of YHWH [is] sure, making wise the simple.

segments.text: The law of YHWH [is] perfect, refreshing the soul; the testimony of YHWH [is] sure, making wise the simple.

verses.text: The statutes of YHWH [are] straight, making glad the heart; the commandment of YHWH [is] pure, bringing light to the eyes.

segments.text: The statutes of YHWH [are] straight, making glad the heart; the commandment of YHWH [is] pure, bringing light to the eyes.

verses.text: The fear of YHWH is pure, standing forever; the judgments of YHWH [are] true, being righteous altogether,

segments.text: The fear of YHWH is pure, standing forever; the judgments of YHWH [are] true, being righteous altogether,

verses.text: being desired above gold, and much above pure gold, and sweeter than honey and flowing honey from the honeycomb.

segments.text: being desired above gold, and much above pure gold, and sweeter than honey and flowing honey from the honeycomb.

verses.text: Indeed, Your servant is warned by them; in keeping them [is] great reward.

segments.text: Indeed, Your servant is warned by them; in keeping them [is] great reward.

verses.text: Who can discern [his] errors? From the hidden cleanse me.

segments.text: Who can discern [his] errors? From the hidden cleanse me.

verses.text: Also, hold back Your servant from proud [things]; may they not rule over me. Then I shall be complete, and cleansed of great transgression.

segments.text: Also, hold back Your servant from proud [things]; may they not rule over me. Then I shall be complete, and cleansed of great transgression.

verses.text: The words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart, let them be for favor before Your face, O YHWH, my Rock and my Redeemer.
